claim_boundary: An outcome-informed development replay on two consumed 512-state rosters. A pass can authorize preregistration of one new disjoint static confirmation for the fixed K48-plus-polish/K9 method. It is not independent confirmation, trajectory authorization, candidate-side canonical exactness, all-queue policy equivalence, capacity at the old point loads, stability, or a physical multi-GPU result.

decision_rule.INVALID_EXECUTION: one or more registered execution-integrity checks fail
decision_rule.SINGLE_EXCHANGE_DEVELOPMENT_ACTION_IDENT: support passes but a polished R8/K48 action differs from the exact canonical reference on at least one consumed-roster state
decision_rule.SINGLE_EXCHANGE_DEVELOPMENT_COMPUTE_FAIL: support and action identity pass but charged LP, matrix, or candidate-evaluation work is not strictly below cold K4096 per roster or in aggregate
decision_rule.SINGLE_EXCHANGE_DEVELOPMENT_SUPPORT_FAIL: the polished R8/K48 certificate or actual regret fails an envelope-normalized support gate on at least one consumed roster
decision_rule.SINGLE_EXCHANGE_READY_FOR_NEW_INDEPENDEN: R8/K48 plus the frozen single-exchange polish passes support, action identity, and charged-work gates on both consumed rosters and in aggregate; retained R16/K9 source evidence remains passing

method_contract.certificate: retain the base certified upper bound and exactness flags; update only the feasible incumbent action, score, gap, and epsilon
method_contract.charged_work: add every unique exchange attempt, including infeasible attempts, to candidate evaluations and residual option probes; add no LP or matrix work
method_contract.choice: maximize exact Fraction support score; break score ties by ascending (duration, sorted option indices with idle last)
method_contract.neighborhood: every unique option-count vector obtained by moving one lane from each occupied real-option or idle symbol to each different real-option or idle symbol
method_contract.r16_disposition: R16/K9 is unchanged and no polish is applied
method_contract.reference_independence: the polish reads no K4096 action, score, bound, or work value

protocol.prohibited: changing the trigger, neighborhood, tie-break, work accounting, budgets, loads, or consumed rosters after registration; reading K4096 inside the polish; using these consumed rosters as confirmation; generating a new roster; arrivals, trajectories, run-time RNG, server pulls, and paper edits
